subject: calderMobile
pitch:
Category: Abstract.
Subject: hanging mobile.
Style: Alexander Calder.

requests.what: Add three small punched circular details and a slim INK outline on the warm YELLOW hanging plate, with one tiny BRASS rivet at the suspension point.
Add a floating vermilion crescent slash and two tiny cream rivets on the ORANGE side-turned plate; keep the marks graphic and spare in the Calder style.
Add a small YELLOW triangular cutout and a dark blue pin near the upper third of the GREEN lower-left plate.
Add a thin CREAM orbital arc with one RED dot across the COBALT circular plate, all seated close to its front face.
Add a smaller INK diamond inset inside the RED diamond, plus one tiny YELLOW bead at its lower point.
Add two narrow CORAL diagonal veins and a small BRASS eyelet on the long TURQUOISE leaf plate.
Add a tiny CREAM disc with a dark ring on the central PURPLE drop, aligned to the front and no larger than one quarter of its width.
Add a restrained BRASS collar and a small RED enamel bead around the central pivot where the top suspension wire meets the main rod.
Paint the YELLOW plate with a flat two-tone geometric pattern: warm YELLOW field, a broad RED-orange offset band, and a few clean INK marks. Preserve the simple cut-metal silhouette.
Paint the ORANGE plate with a sparse Calder-like color block: ORANGE field, one YELLOW wedge, and a small deep RED counter-shape. Keep it matte and graphic.
Paint the TURQUOISE leaf with alternating TURQUOISE and BLUE angular bands, leaving generous plain metal around the edges and keeping the shape readable from a distance.
Paint the COBALT disc with a very restrained cream-and-INK radial mark, like a hand-cut abstract target, without obscuring its circular silhouette.
